title: Piper in the Woods
summary: "Piper in the Woods" by Philip K. Dick is a science fiction short story first published in 1953. When soldiers return from asteroid Y-3 claiming to be plants, army doctor Henry Harris investigates the mysterious phenomenon. Harris travels to the asteroid to uncover the truth behind these bizarre claims, leading to a discovery that challenges his understanding of escape, reality, and the human mind's response to overwhelming pressure.
